reason: Telescoping gives \(\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}H_k=G_0-G_N\). Substituting the endpoint forms yields \(\sum H_k=M(A_0B_N-A_NB_0)/(B_0B_N)\), so one may take \(A=A_0B_N-A_NB_0\) and \(B=B_0B_N\). In the UFD \(\mathbf{Z}[q]\), any common nonunit divisor of \(B_0B_N\) and \(M\) has an irreducible factor dividing \(M\) and also dividing \(B_0\) or \(B_N\), contradicting \(\gcd(B_0,M)=\gcd(B_N,M)=1\). Therefore \(\gcd(B,M)=1\).
